source_agency: DGCI&S / Department of Commerce, Government of India
coverage_banner_verbatim: Data available:Jan 2018 to Jun 2026 ((R) Revised Final upto Mar 2026, (F) Final upto Jun 2026)
request_design: A query for (month M, year Y) returns two data columns, M-(Y-1) and M-Y. 12 months x 4 years = 48 requests cover the 96-month panel.

parser_completeness_spotcheck.method: sum of all parsed HS-6 rows vs MEIDB's own India's Total Export line

revision_policy: DGCI&S Dynamic Data Revision Policy restates prior months of the current financial year on every release. Re-pull in full; never append.
raw_preservation_note: In-session extraction preserved the parsed HS-6 rows for every basket code plus reconciliation aggregates and B1 code-level detail, all retrieval-date stamped. Full raw HTML archiving (one gzipped response per request) is performed by 05_analysis/fetch_meidb.py when run locally.
